options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Active DLCs
options.doc:
Select which DLCs are active. 
Enabling a DLC dynamically injects its licenses and items into the item pool.
Options: dlc_ice_cream, dlc_bakery, dlc_vending, dlc_essentials, dlc_hardware, dlc_electronics, dlc_clothing
Recommended: Enable all DLCs (only if you own them).

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
The victory condition for your Archipelago round.
Level: Reach the configured maximum store level.
Days: Complete the configured maximum number of operating days.
All Licenses: Collect every product license in the item pool (base game + active DLCs).
Recommended: All Licenses.

options.name: Price Randomization
options.doc:
Randomizes the prices of items in the store. This affects the price you pay for items, not the selling price of your products!.
Disabled: Standard prices.
Balanced: Prices vary by up to +/- 20%.
Chaotic: Prices vary by up to +/- 50%. Margins remain stable.
Recommended: Balanced.

options.name: Max Store Level
options.doc:
The maximum store level that will contain locations (checks).
Recommended: Depends how long you want to play.

options.name: Store Level Interval
options.doc:
How many levels should be between individual checks. E.g., 2 means Level 2, 4, 6...
Recommended: 1
options.doc_fr:
Combien de niveaux devraient être entre les contrôles individuels. Par exemple, 2 signifie le niveau 2, 4, 6...
Recommended: 1

options.name: Max Days Completed
options.doc:
The maximum number of completed days that contain checks.
Recommended: 100

options.name: Days Completed Interval
options.doc:
How many completed days should be between checks. E.g., 5 means Day 5, 10, 15...
Recommended: 1
options.doc_fr:
Combien de jours devraient être accomplis entre les vérifications. Par exemple, 5 signifie Jour 5, 10, 15...
Recommended: 1

options.name: Enable Furniture Locks
options.doc:
If enabled, furniture (fridges, shelves) is locked behind AP items.
If disabled, they are immediately available and removed from the item pool.
Recommended: Enabled.
options.doc_fr:
Si activé, les meubles (réfrigérateurs, étagères) sont verrouillés derrière les objets AP.
Si elles sont désactivées, elles sont immédiatement disponibles et retirées du pool d'articles.
Recommended: Activé.

options.name: Enable Vehicle Locks
options.doc:
If enabled, vehicles are locked behind AP items.
If disabled, they are immediately available.
Recommended: Enabled.
options.doc_fr:
Si activé, les véhicules sont verrouillés derrière les éléments AP.
Si elles sont handicapées, elles sont immédiatement disponibles.
Recommended: Activé.

options.name: Enable Storage Locks
options.doc:
If enabled, storage room upgrades are locked behind AP items and also act as checks.
If disabled, they are immediately available and removed from the item pool.
Recommended: Enabled.
options.doc_fr:
Si activé, les mises à niveau de la salle de stockage sont verrouillées derrière les éléments AP et agissent également comme des vérifications.
Si elles sont désactivées, elles sont immédiatement disponibles et retirées du pool d'articles.
Recommended: Activé.

options.name: Enable Section Locations
options.doc:
If enabled, buy section room locations can be generated.
Recommended: Enabled.
options.doc_fr:
Si elle est activée, vous pouvez générer des emplacements de salle de section d'achat.
Recommended: Activé.

options.name: Enable Loan Locks
options.doc:
If enabled, credit line licenses (1-6) are locked behind AP items.
If disabled, they are immediately available and removed from the item pool.
Recommended: Enabled.
options.doc_fr:
Si activé, les licences de ligne de crédit (1-6) sont verrouillées derrière les éléments AP.
Si elles sont désactivées, elles sont immédiatement disponibles et retirées du pool d'articles.
Recommended: Activé.

options.name: Exclude Progression From Late Checks
options.doc:
Prevents items with any progression classification from being placed in the final 20% of generated Day, Store Level, and Customer Checkout locations.
This applies to items for every player. Filler, traps, and useful-only items remain allowed.
Recommended: Disabled.

options.name: Enable Traps
options.doc:
If enabled, harmful trap items can be generated as fillers.
Recommended: Enabled unless you want a more peaceful experience.
options.doc_fr:
Si activé, les éléments de piège nuisibles peuvent être générés comme remplisseurs.
Recommended: Activer sauf si vous voulez une expérience plus pacifique.

options.name: Trap Frequency
options.doc:
The percentage chance (0-100) that a filler item becomes a trap instead of a booster.
Recommended: 20

options.name: Disabled Traps
options.doc:
Set of traps that should be excluded from generation.
    Recommended: None unless you want to avoid specific traps.
Available options:
- Tax Audit Trap
- Dust Storm Trap
- Power Outage Trap
- Trash Flood Trap
- Expired Products Trap
- Robbery Trap

options.name: Filler Money Weight
options.doc:
Generation weight for money boosters.
Recommended: 50
options.doc_fr:
Poids de génération pour les boosters d'argent.
Recommended: 50

options.name: Filler XP Weight
options.doc:
Generation weight for store XP boosters.
Recommended: 50
options.doc_fr:
Poids de génération pour les boosters XP.
Recommended: 50

options.name: Enable Black Friday Events
options.doc:
If enabled, Black Friday events can be generated as fillers.
Recommended: Enabled
options.doc_fr:
Si activé, les événements Black Friday peuvent être générés comme des remplissages.
Recommended: Activé

options.name: Filler Black Friday Weight
options.doc:
Generation weight for Black Friday events.
Recommended: 10
options.doc_fr:
Poids de génération pour les événements du vendredi noir.
Recommended: 10

options.name: Enable Money Milestones
options.doc:
If enabled, reaching specific money milestones unlocks Archipelago checks. You must hold this amount of money, not just earn it total.
Recommended: Enabled
options.doc_fr:
Si activé, atteindre des jalons financiers spécifiques débloque les vérifications d'archipel. Vous devez garder ce montant d'argent, pas seulement le gagner total.
Recommended: Activé

options.name: Max Money Milestone
options.doc:
The maximum amount of money that includes checks.
Recommended: 25000 because the game is designed to use your money to unlock checks and progress. Setting this too high can make the checks difficult to achieve.

options.name: Money Milestone Interval
options.doc:
The interval between money checks (e.g., every $5000).
Recommended: 2000-5000

options.name: Vending Machine Slots
options.doc:
The number of Vending Machine Slot licenses placed in the item pool.
Each item allows buying an additional vending machine slot in the computer.
dlc_vending must be enabled for this option to have any effect.
Recommended: Set it to the number of vending machine slots you want to be able to buy in the game.

options.name: Checkout Income Multiplier
options.doc:
Multiplies the payout received at the cash register/self-checkout when customers pay.
Represented in percentage (100 = 1.0x, 120 = 1.2x, 80 = 0.8x).
Recommended: 100 (1.0x) but you can increase it to make the game easier or decrease it to make the game harder.
options.doc_fr:
Multiplie le paiement reçu à la caisse enregistreuse/auto-vérification lorsque les clients paient.
Représenté en pourcentage (100 = 1,0x, 120 = 1,2x, 80 = 0,8x).
Recommended: 100 (1.0x) mais vous pouvez l'augmenter pour rendre le jeu plus facile ou le réduire pour rendre le jeu plus difficile.

options.name: Starting Cash
options.doc:
The cash the player starts with in a new game. Default game starts with $50.
Recommended: 50 (Game default) but you can increase it to make the game easier.

options.name: Free Customizables
options.doc:
If enabled, all store customization options (wall paint, floor tiles, store rename, door placement, entrance variants) cost $0.
Since these are normally cosmetic-only, this option does not affect the game balance.
Recommended: Your preference, but it can make the game more fun to customize your store without worrying about money.
options.doc_fr:
Si activé, toutes les options de personnalisation de magasin (peinture de mur, carrelage, renommer le magasin, emplacement de porte, variantes d'entrée) coûtent 0 $.
Comme ils sont normalement cosmétiques, cette option n'affecte pas l'équilibre du jeu.
Recommended: Votre préférence, mais il peut rendre le jeu plus amusant de personnaliser votre magasin sans se soucier de l'argent.

options.name: Customer Checkout Locations
options.doc:
Number of Customer Checkout location checks generated. Every time a customer checks out, there is a chance to trigger a check at one of these locations.
Recommended: 200 (Depends on how long you want to play.)
options.doc_fr:
Nombre de vérifications de localisation du client générées. Chaque fois qu'un client vérifie, il y a une chance de déclencher un contrôle à l'un de ces endroits.
Recommended: 200 (Pendant combien de temps vous voulez jouer.)

options.name: Customer Checkout Chance
options.doc:
Percentage chance (40-100%) per checked-out customer to trigger a Customer Checkout location check.
Recommended: 50 (Depends on a mix of how much Location you have and how long you want to play.)
options.doc_fr:
Pourcentage de chance (40-100%) par client vérifié pour déclencher une vérification de l'emplacement de la vérification du client.
Recommended: 50 (Pendant sur un mélange de combien d'emplacement vous avez et combien de temps vous voulez jouer.)

options.name: Local Checkout Fill Percentage
options.doc:
Percentage of Customer Checkout locations pre-filled with local filler/trap items before global multiworld placement.

Host Thresholds (enforced unless server host permits lower minimums):
- Up to 500 checks: minimum 55% local fill
- 501 to 2000 checks: minimum 90% local fill
- Over 2000 checks: minimum 97% local fill
- Maximum global multiworld checkout items: 400 max cap

Recommended: 60
options.doc_fr:
Pourcentage d'emplacements de vérification des clients pré-remplis avec des articles de remplissage/trap locaux avant le placement mondial multimonde.

Seuils de l'hôte (enforcement sauf si l'hôte du serveur permet des minimums inférieurs) :
- Up to 500 checks: minimum 55% de remplissage local
- 501 to 2000 checks: minimum 90 % de remplissage local
- Over 2000 checks: minimum 97% remplissage local
- Maximum mondial multimonde articles de commande: 400 maximum

Recommended: 60
